description: This file implements a service for managing agent nodes including starting, stopping, and monitoring their status. It handles process management, registry persistence, environment setup, and interactions with agent nodes via HTTP API calls. The code is part of an internal core services package for an agent management system.

classes.name: DefaultAgentService
classes.description: Implements agent management functions such as starting, stopping, and status checking, utilizing process management, registry management, and HTTP API calls.

methods.name: RunAgent
methods.description: Starts an agent node by allocating a port, configuring the process environment, and launching the process, then updates registry with runtime info.

methods.name: StopAgent
methods.description: Stops a running agent node via HTTP request or process signals, updating registry and handling process termination robustly.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of an agent, reconciling registry info with actual process state.

methods.name: ListRunningAgents
methods.description: Returns a list of all agents currently marked as running.

methods.name: loadRegistryDirect
methods.description: Loads the install registry directly from a YAML file.

methods.name: saveRegistryDirect
methods.description: Saves the current registry state to disk.

methods.name: convertToRunningAgent
methods.description: Converts an installed package record to a runtime domain object.

methods.name: buildProcessConfig
methods.description: Constructs process configuration including environment variables and virtual environment setup.

methods.name: waitForAgentNode
methods.description: Polls a health endpoint to wait until the agent node is ready.

methods.name: updateRuntimeInfo
methods.description: Updates the registry with runtime details such as port and PID.

methods.name: displayCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent node capabilities like reasoners and skills via HTTP API.

methods.name: findAgentInRegistry
methods.description: Finds an agent in the registry, normalizing name formats for matching.

methods.name: loadPackageEnvFile
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a package's .env file.

methods.name: findPythonExecutable
methods.description: Attempts to locate an appropriate Python interpreter executable.

methods.name: reconcileProcessState
methods.description: Checks if the registry-specified process corresponds to an active OS process, updating the registry if discrepancies are found.
